# A whole plant from an anther

## Two Indian scientists

The anther is the part of a flower that makes pollen grains. Sipra Guha Mukherjee, working with S. C. Maheshwari, made a breakthrough discovery in plant tissue culture. Their research led to a complete plant being grown through anther culture, using an artificial nutrient medium under controlled laboratory conditions.

## Why it mattered

This pioneering work helped greatly in crop improvement, which means getting better crop plants. It also brought major progress in modern agriculture.

**Tissue culture does not only start from roots and stems: a complete plant can also be grown from an anther of a flower.**
